Call Explorer requires the Einstein Conversation Insights permission set to be enabled.

explanation: Call Explorer is part of Einstein Conversation Insights, so users need the Einstein Conversation Insights permission set (with ECI enabled and call recordings connected) before they can use it. It doesn't need custom actions built first, and its setup has nothing to do with Salesforce Knowledge.

text: After a project deployment, end users identified several bugs that the project team prioritized. How should a consultant resolve these issues?

options.text: Build out the issue resolution release in the staging environment.
Build out the issue resolution release in a development sandbox.
Perform user acceptance testing (UAT) in a development sandbox.

explanation: Exam key: build the issue-resolution release in the staging environment. Note: fixes normally follow the standard path of building in a development sandbox, testing in staging/UAT and then deploying to production; the previous bank keyed the development-sandbox option. UAT doesn't belong in a development sandbox.
reviewNote: Key taken from the sales sets; the previous bank (Q104) keyed "Build out the issue resolution release in a development sandbox".

text: Cloud Kicks has completed its initial implementation and wants to create a culture of continuous improvement. What should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Establish a Center of Excellence (COE).
Configure an enablement site.
Implement a continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) deployment pipeline.

explanation: A Center of Excellence brings together business owners, admins and executive sponsors to govern the platform, prioritize enhancements and share best practices, which is how continuous improvement is sustained after go-live. An enablement site or a CI/CD pipeline are tools a COE might use, not the culture-building structure itself.

text: An AI model trained on global data underperforms in regions with specific cultural and language nuances. Which Salesforce trusted AI principle should guide the next steps?

options.text: Empowering
Inclusive
Responsible

explanation: The model underperforms for people whose cultural and language nuances weren't well represented, which falls under the Inclusive principle: AI should be trained and tested on diverse, representative data so it serves everyone it affects. Responsible and Empowering cover other parts of Salesforce's trusted AI principles.

text: CK acquired a shoe distribution partner and wants to migrate its sales and marketing data into CK's Sales Cloud. Which aspect should the consultant consider first?

options.text: Role hierarchy and sharing rules set up prior to migration
Number of marketing campaign licenses required for the migration
Volume of customer, partner, and prospect data identified prior to migration

explanation: Exam key: settle the role hierarchy and sharing rules before migrating, so incoming records land with the right owners and visibility and sharing doesn't have to be recalculated afterwards. Note: the previous bank keyed identifying the volume of customer, partner and prospect data first, because data volume drives the migration approach and tooling.
reviewNote: Key taken from the sales sets; the previous bank (Q66) keyed "Volume of customer, partner, and prospect data".

text: Sales managers want a dashboard to track their team's potentially problematic opportunities. Which metric should the consultant recommend?

options.text: Opportunities viewed in a certain period of time
Opportunities that are missing Price Book information
Opportunities that are missing activities

explanation: Exam key: opportunities missing Price Book information. Note: the usual sign that an opportunity is at risk is a lack of activity, since deals reps aren't working tend to stall; the previous bank's variant keyed opportunities with no recorded activities. Missing price book data is a data-quality gap rather than a deal-risk signal.
reviewNote: Contested: opportunities with no activity is the usual at-risk metric. The previous bank's variant (Q243) keyed it.

text: The Cloud Kicks sales team collaborates on opportunities. What should the consultant configure so contributing team members share in the revenue from closed opportunities?

options.text: Enable Opportunity Splits from Setup.
Create a custom field on the Opportunity.
Create child opportunities using Quick Actions.

explanation: Opportunity Splits, enabled from Setup, let team members share credit for an opportunity's revenue (revenue splits that total 100%, or overlay splits for supporting roles), and the splits roll into reports and forecasts. A custom field or child opportunities would need custom logic and break forecasting.
